# Metron — GitHub Copilot repository briefing

**Canonical source of truth:** Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), including its start-of-task checklist, rather than relying on previous chat context.

For intent routing read [docs/navigation.json](../docs/navigation.json); for current capabilities read [metron.manifest.json](../metron.manifest.json); for historical decisions read [docs/adr/index.json](../docs/adr/index.json).

Preserve the lightweight **Questions → Experiments → Decisions → Code** culture. Consequential changes should use a PR and link an Issue/ADR when relevant; trivial fixes do not require new paperwork. Keep human summaries short and evidence optional but accessible. Distinguish software tests from empirical physiological validation.
